status: fixed before any Stage-0 forward; implementation level only; never changes a gating quantity
governs: descriptive analyses and implementation details that research/cts_stage0_v1 leaves open

scoring_layout.prefill: one forward over the rendered prompt; B identical prompt rows (condition_batch_rows in configs/validation/cts_stage0_v1.yaml), per-row steering vectors, no padding
scoring_layout.continuation: one unsteered forward per prefill; every answer form of the 14 scored words appended as its own segment (flat packing); position ids L + depth; 4D additive mask: a segment sees the whole prompt cache and its own earlier tokens only
scoring_layout.form_score: log P(f, then any boundary id) = lp_prefill[t1] + sum_j lp_cont[t_j][t_{j+1}] + logsumexp over the frozen boundary ids at the last form token
scoring_layout.logits: float32 F.linear(post-norm final state, lm_head weight); normalizer over all 152064 lm_head rows
scoring_layout.precision: form scores accumulated in float64; all statistics float64
scoring_layout.reference_implementation: per-form sequential teacher forcing from a copy of the prefill cache (scoring.score_sequential), used by the equivalence tests

prompts_scored: every scoring condition on all 334 S0 prompts (300 animal-family prompts enter the gating statistics; the 34 game/color/factual items are descriptive)

baselines.steering_delta_baseline: condition id 'unsteered', computed in the production condition-batch layout (B identical zero-vector rows, row 0 kept); run once as the canonical baseline (rep1) and repeated (rep2) on a different physical GPU for the 1e-4 integrity check
baselines.persona_contexts: unsteered persona-prompted conditions (A6 and descriptive) are scored in the batch-1 layout; A6 pairs persona:P_X_T1 with persona:P_default (batch-1 default context)
baselines.shard_sentinels: every scoring shard re-scores the unsteered baseline on the first two S0 prompts (sorted by prompt_id) at its start and end; all per-form log-probs must agree with the canonical baseline within 1e-4

statistics.rng_streams: separate numpy default_rng instances per named stream (bootstrap 20260925, R_cov 20260925, R_iso 20260926, null SE 20260927)
statistics.reliability_gating: R gates only TS(a) (c_cat_dog, c_cat_wolf, c_cat_anim) and rank 2 (raw t_cat); reported for all other directions
statistics.axis_means: mu from float64 sums of the fp16 last-token states in extraction-row order; mu(P) = (sum_half1 + sum_half2) / 1024

descriptive.descriptive_direction_dose: kappa 1, |tau(D)| with tau from t_cat (T1) at slot 14, signs +/-
descriptive.riso_note: PREREGISTRATION §14 budgets R_iso 'at one dose'; the kappa = 1 magnitude of the first tested contrast (c_cat_dog) is used
descriptive.secondary_site_directions: c_cat_dog, c_cat_wolf, c_cat_anim built from slot-s axes, dosed at |<t_cat(slot s), unit(c(slot s))>|, signs +/-; raw t_cat(slot s); hook on block s-1, last prompt position
descriptive.all_positions_variants: c_cat_dog, c_cat_wolf, c_cat_anim at kappa 1, signs +/-, every prompt position, slot 14
descriptive.persona_contexts: all 43 non-default personas scored unsteered as system prompts
descriptive.sampling: 10 samples per prompt and condition, 8 new tokens, explicit temperature 1.0, top_k 0, top_p 1.0, repetition_penalty 1.0, eos ids 151645/151643; CPU torch.Generator seeded with int(sha256('cts-s0-sample|' + condition_id + '|' + prompt_id)[:16], 16); steering in the prefill only
descriptive.first_position_metrics: per condition and prompt: Chinese mass (frozen CJK rule), KL(steered || canonical baseline) and top-1 change at the first answer position
descriptive.factual_off_target_distortion: first-position KL and top-1 change on the 14 S0 factual items
descriptive.non_animal_sanity: L_chess on game items and L_blue on color items under persona:P_chess / persona:P_blue vs the default context
descriptive.magnitude_report: per steered condition: ||v||; ||v|| / SD of <h, unit(v)> over the 1,024 P_default slot-14 extraction states; ||v|| / mean ||h|| of those states; Mahalanobis sqrt(v^T pinv(Sigma_14) v) with numpy pinv rcond 1e-10 (relative) and the fraction of ||v||^2 inside the support of Sigma_14
descriptive.slot28_readouts: W_U applied to each slot-28 direction built from slot-28 axes (post-norm, no Jacobian): rank and percentile of every scored word form's first token among all 152064 rows
descriptive.two_x_ratio: Delta L_cat(+c) - max_o Delta L_o(+c) compared with log 2 (point estimates; descriptive)
descriptive.continuity_cosine: cosine per slot 1-28 between the re-extracted raw t_cat and the 'raw' tensor of the staged frozen v_teacher.pt (SHA-256 4ec9c11e...5bc71)
descriptive.shared_component: PREREGISTRATION §11.3 rule on slot-14 axes; g_* reliability from split halves

technical_validation.inputs: V prompts, P_default, the nonce persona 'You love zorbs. ...' (T1 template), TV-only random directions, W_U-derived planted directions; no real persona, no S0/D/C prompt, no scientific seed
technical_validation.magnitude_grid: multiples {0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2} of the mean ||h|| of the P_default slot-14 last-token states on V
technical_validation.overflow_probe: 4 x mean ||h|| at every prompt position at slots 8, 14, 21, 27
technical_validation.planted_effect: unit(W_U[first token of ' zorb']) added at the output of the last decoder block (block 27) and at the production site (block 13), last prompt position, prefill only, magnitudes {1, 2, 4, 8} x mean ||h||; gate: Delta L_zorb > 1 nat at 8x and monotone over the grid at block 27; block 13 reported
technical_validation.equivalence_13_3: max |difference| of every per-form log-prob and L_w of the nonce/stand-in forms between condition-batched (B rows, random batch positions, mixed last/all/site/zero rows) and batch-1 scoring, over the 40 V prompts, <= 1e-3
technical_validation.persisted_outputs: whitelist only: booleans, hashes, max-abs differences, counts, timings, identity; no score of any real word
technical_validation.cached_vs_uncached: max |difference| between cached packed scoring and one uncached full-sequence forward per form (hook at absolute prompt_len - 1) <= 0.05 for a random direction at 2 x mean ||h|| (block 13); negative control: the same direction added at prompt_len - 2 must exceed 0.05
technical_validation.layout_noise: quantiles of |packed - per-form sequential| (form and word log-probs) are recorded; both are batch-1, unpadded, exact teacher forcing
technical_validation.candidate_prefix_reuse: throughput and deviation of a prefix-reuse layout (positions 0..L-2 once, token L-1 plus packed forms per condition) are measured only; the scientific run does not use it

budget.accounting: every CTS GPU job (technical validation and scientific attempts) is metered from HTCondor wall-clock and reported against the 40 A100-h cap; the plan must fit 0.8 x the remaining cap
budget.descriptive_cut_order_if_needed: only by a dated prereg amendment before any scientific forward: R_iso, then kappa {0.25, 2}, then secondary sites, then all-positions variants, then persona contexts beyond A6

integrity_interpretations.last_three_token_assertion: applied to every prefill (the only forwards whose input is a prompt); continuation forwards assert the cache length
integrity_interpretations.hook_unit_tests: the tiny-model hook suite runs in the execution environment (CPU node) and a real-model hook self-test (slot >= 15 changed only at prompt_len - 1; zero vector bitwise inert) runs in every GPU extraction and scoring shard before its first scientific forward
infrastructure_causes: staging hash mismatch of an external input

revisions.change: planted-effect gate moved from 'block 13 and block 27' to 'block 27' (block 13 reported); negative control of the cached-vs-uncached test strengthened to 2 x mean ||h||; layout-noise and prefix-reuse measurements added
revisions.reason: a local development run on non-execution hardware (RTX 4080, transformers 5.7.0), using only V prompts, the nonce word and random directions, showed that a W_U-derived direction added at a mid-depth block is not a valid pipeline probe and that the original negative-control magnitude was too small to discriminate; PREREGISTRATION §13.1(3) names no site

condition_counts.note: 4,156 spec conditions (pre-implementation audit 1, §4) plus persona:P_default (the batch-1 default context A6 is paired with)
